visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a wide shot of the iconic Bic Camera building in Tokyo, Japan. The exterior features a prominent red and white sign on a grey gridded facade under a bright, clear blue sky. A massive digital screen displays a high-resolution advertisement, and several pedestrians are visible walking near the ground-level entrance. (2) Inside the store, a retail shelf displays the 'Brighte' hair dryer. A hand reaches out to hold the sleek, black, minimalist device. Behind it, a promotional poster shows a woman with smooth hair and product details. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a professional electronics showroom. (3) The camera focuses on the 'BISARA STICK', a long, slender hair dryer that looks like a metallic wand. A hand holds and rotates the device to reveal tactile buttons and a narrow vertical nozzle. The background includes price tags, white display shelves, and other color variants of the same product line. (4) The 'Zuvi Halo' hair dryer is presented on a white display stand. It has a unique, circular, fan-like head with a white and metallic color scheme. The lighting highlights the glossy finish of the plastic. The setting remains the clean, organized retail environment of the electronics department. (5) Two 'Re-De' brand hair dryers are shown in dark grey and copper colors, perched on thin vertical stands. The camera captures their compact, foldable design and elegant textures. Informative signs with text and graphics about power consumption are visible on the shelf next to the items. (6) The video concludes by showing 'BISARA' floor-standing hair dryers. Three tall, telescopic stands in white, grey, and silver are lined up against a white wall. The shot is a medium full shot that emphasizes the height and hands-free convenience of these innovative lifestyle appliances.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: BIG CAMERA. [Variety]: 2025 新式吹風機 3 選. [Logo]: 日本失心瘋 ジャパンナッツ. (2) [Subtitle]: 留言+1 索取詳細資料. [Logo]: Brighte. [Slogan]: 主打奈米級噴霧技術 吹乾頭髮同時幫髮絲補水保濕 最近廣告打很兇. (3) [Logo]: BISARA STICK. [Slogan]: 主打可吹出高集中直線強風 無刷馬達實現低噪音 還有專利保濕離子打造柔順光澤髮. (4) [Logo]: Zuvi Halo. [Slogan]: 主打無線使用，能自由走動 只要19分鐘就能急速充電. (5) [Logo]: Re-De. [Slogan]: Re-De這支也很漂亮 細細長長，可摺疊 也有架子可以放著直接吹髮. (6) [Logo]: BISARA. [Slogan]: 現在也很流行直立式吹風機 實現雙手自由，邊滑手機邊吹髮.
